sources.title: Black Holes and Large N Species Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can an exactly conserved charge have unlimited range if it creates no classical long-range field and returning it through available carriers has a nonzero energy cost?

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: The background permits a semiclassical test of a charged scalar whose mass is too large to discharge an extremal black hole along a chosen charge direction. A large radius suppresses curvature while the charge projection q·Q can remain large.

sources.title: The emergence of universal relations in the AdS black holes thermodynamics

evidence.text: Does a small constant deformation of the cosmological term reproduce entropy–extremality relations across selected AdS black holes, extend them to other thermodynamic conjugates, and support a WGC-like interpretation of corrected mass-to-charge behavior?

sources.title: Black Holes and Large N Species Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can the charge-return argument survive if massive species decay, provided their lifetimes exceed the relevant black-hole evaporation time?

sources.title: Black Holes and Large N Species Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: How much exactly conserved charge can a black hole store when each of N equal-mass species carries its own independent binary charge?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: How do Gauss–Bonnet corrections affect renormalized charges, thermodynamics and scalar attractor behavior of static charged AdS black holes, including extremal solutions?

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: What are the leading α′ corrections to d-dimensional black holes carrying fundamental-string momentum and winding charges, and how do those corrections affect gravitational thermodynamics, entropy and mass/charge relations?

sources.title: Black Strings, Low Viscosity Fluids, and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional black string, and can its horizon develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to exterior observers in finite asymptotic time?

sources.title: Final state of Gregory–Laflamme instability

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional vacuum black string, and does its evolution imply a naked singularity in finite time measured by asymptotic observers?

sources.title: Fencing in the Swampland: Quantum Gravity Constraints on Large Field Inflation

evidence.text: Can extremal black holes discharge without leaving arbitrarily many stable charged remnants? The two versions differ in whether any suitable state suffices or the lightest relevant state must be superextremal.

sources.title: End Point of Black Ring Instabilities and the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: What are the nonlinear endpoints of black-ring instabilities, and can sufficiently thin rings provide evidence for weak cosmic censorship violation in asymptotically flat five-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: Tunneling method for Hawking radiation in the Nariai case

evidence.text: Can exact field solutions on charged Nariai spacetime corroborate Hamilton–Jacobi tunneling for Hawking radiation, and what probability does the usual semiclassical emission factor represent?

sources.title: Evidence for an Electrifying Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can localized electric boundary forcing in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS Einstein–Maxwell theory drive smooth initial data toward arbitrarily large curvature visible to distant observers, providing a counterexample to the version of cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: Generalized Charged Nariai Solutions in Arbitrary Even Dimensions with Multiple Magnetic Charges

evidence.text: Can even-dimensional charged Nariai geometries built from two-dimensional factors carry several magnetic charges, arise as limits of black-hole solutions, and extend to gravitational theories with higher-curvature terms?

sources.title: End Point of the Ultraspinning Instability and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the axisymmetric ultraspinning instability of six-dimensional Myers–Perry black holes, and does its evolution provide evidence for a violation of weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Violating the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Four-Dimensional Anti–de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Can initially pure four-dimensional AdS, driven by a localized boundary electric field, develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to boundary observers, violating the version of weak cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Can an unlimited collection of globally charged black-hole states coexist with a sensible quantum theory of gravity?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein--null dust system with an inner mirror

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, Cauchy-stable perturbations of AdS develop trapped surfaces through repeated reflections, in the spherically symmetric Einstein–null dust model with a shrinking inner mirror?

sources.title: The Einstein--null dust system in spherical symmetry with an inner mirror: structure of the maximal development and Cauchy stability

evidence.text: Does an inner reflecting mirror restore well-posedness for spherical Einstein–null dust with AdS asymptotics, and can Cauchy stability be controlled uniformly as the mirror radius shrinks?

sources.title: Testing the Weak Gravity - Cosmic Censorship Connection

evidence.text: Does adding a sufficiently charged scalar remove the proposed electrically driven AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and does the minimum charge needed for regular endpoints coincide with the proposed AdS weak-gravity bound?

sources.title: Extremal Tunneling and Anti-de Sitter Instantons

evidence.text: Does the backreacted effective action for charged spherical-shell emission reduce to the horizon tunneling integral, including superradiant and extremal limits, and what decay processes does it imply in the near-horizon AdS geometry?

sources.title: Quasinormal Modes in Generalized Nariai Spacetimes

evidence.text: Which horizon boundary conditions produce discrete quasinormal spectra for spin-0, spin-1/2, and spin-1 test fields on generalized charged Nariai backgrounds, and can their frequencies be obtained analytically?

sources.title: A Note on 4D Heterotic String Vacua, FI-terms and the Swampland

evidence.text: Could requiring extremal black holes to discharge explain the availability of massless heterotic charges that cancel anomalous FI terms?

sources.title: Attempts at vacuum counterexamples to cosmic censorship in AdS

evidence.text: Can boundary differential rotation produce vacuum AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship by driving stationary solutions beyond a finite rotation amplitude, and what role do boundary ergoregions play?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein-massless Vlasov system

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, smooth, spherically symmetric perturbations of AdS develop trapped spheres under Einstein–massless Vlasov evolution with reflecting conformal infinity, without an inner mirror?

sources.title: The characteristic initial-boundary value problem for the Einstein--massless Vlasov system in spherical symmetry

evidence.text: Establish characteristic well-posedness, continuation criteria and low-regularity finite-time Cauchy stability of AdS for the spherically symmetric Einstein–massless Vlasov system with reflecting conformal infinity.

sources.title: Further evidence for the weak gravity — cosmic censorship connection

evidence.text: Does charged matter satisfying the appropriately modified weak gravity bound remove the boundary-driven AdS counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship when a dilaton or a second Maxwell field is added, and is that bound necessary?

sources.title: Curvature properties of Nariai spacetimes

evidence.text: Which local curvature identities, Einstein-type classifications, tensor compatibility conditions and recurrence structures characterize charged Nariai spacetime and a broader family of direct-product metrics?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Can a black hole carrying one independent discrete gauge charge per species return all charges through thermal emission? The available energy at the emission threshold bounds the number of massive charge carriers it can emit.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Must every charged black hole admit a discharge channel, or can stable charged black holes be consistent with quantum gravity?

sources.title: Black Holes and Large N Species Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Couple a test string to the Stückelberg field strength through a boundary term and compare linked and unlinked histories. Their phase difference detects global hair despite vanishing local classical fields.

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: Evaluate the Euclidean on-shell action through radial total derivatives, obtain entropy through the Gibbs–Duhem relation, and compare with Wald’s horizon Noether-charge formula.

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: Solution generation uses lifting to a uniform black string, two boosts and T-duality, followed by KK reduction. At order α′, the authors use corrected T-duality rules in a Gauss-Bonnet scheme related to the string scheme by field redefinitions.

sources.title: Black Strings, Low Viscosity Fluids, and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: A flow method locates the apparent horizon. Its area, embedding shape, areal radius, and normalized curvature invariants constructed from Riemann contractions are monitored. Convergence tests supply error estimates where available.

sources.title: Final state of Gregory–Laflamme instability

evidence.text: Track the apparent-horizon radius, area, intrinsic embedding geometry and two curvature invariants evaluated on the horizon. Apparent horizons are found with a flow method; convergence comparisons supply some reported errors.

sources.title: Fencing in the Swampland: Quantum Gravity Constraints on Large Field Inflation

evidence.text: Specify a charged wall and two branches, calculate their energy difference at fixed scalar value, and insert tension and energy difference into the cited exponent. Applicability to non-metastable monodromy backgrounds remains unresolved.

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship and weak gravity conjectures in CFT thermodynamics

evidence.text: Under which critical-point parameter conditions can the authors' WGC charge-to-mass criterion coexist with a horizon-based WCCC criterion for RN-AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, using EPST, RPST and boundary CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: Supersymmetry and attractors

evidence.text: Can the horizon area and entropy of supersymmetric extremal black holes be obtained by extremizing the central charge over moduli, explaining their independence from asymptotic scalar values?

sources.title: Cosmic-quantum connections: Assessing the viability of weak gravity and weak cosmic censorship conjectures in Kerr-Newman-Kiselev-Letelier black hole

evidence.text: Can spin, a string cloud, and a quintessence term permit horizon-bearing extremal Kerr–Newman–Kiselev–Letelier configurations with Q²/M²>1, which the authors interpret as compatible with both the mild weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Higher derivative effects on eta/s at finite chemical potential

evidence.text: Does a finite U(1)R chemical potential modify η/s once supersymmetric four-derivative corrections are included, and does it strengthen or weaken violation of the proposed 1/(4π) viscosity bound?

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can curvature-squared corrections violate the conjectured KSS bound η/s ≥ 1/(4π), and do violations correlate with bulk pathologies, inconsistent boundary theories, or restrictions on quantum-gravity embeddings?

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Does reducing shear viscosity in the Gauss-Bonnet holographic model eventually violate boundary microcausality, thereby imposing a consistency-related lower bound on η/s?

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Can a simple gravitational model describe a strongly coupled 2+1-dimensional system with a charged condensate, a superconducting transition and a gap in its frequency-dependent conductivity?

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: How do gravitational backreaction and arbitrary scalar charge affect holographic condensation and transport, and what magnetic response, critical fields and photon mass follow from the model?

sources.title: Real time response on dS(3): The Topological AdS Black Hole and the Bubble

evidence.text: How do real-time correlators distinguish the topological black hole and bubble phases of strongly coupled N=4 SYM on dS3 × S1, reveal cosmological thermal effects, and characterize charge relaxation?

sources.title: Landscape versus Swampland for Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can consistency requirements on holographic boundary theories distinguish negative-cosmological-constant Gauss–Bonnet gravity theories belonging to the string landscape from those in the swampland, and what do these examples imply for viscosity bounds?

sources.title: Holographic Hydrodynamics with a Chemical Potential

evidence.text: How do general four-derivative bulk interactions change finite-chemical-potential thermodynamics, shear viscosity and conductivity, and what happens to conjectured transport bounds?

sources.title: Emergent quantum criticality, Fermi surfaces, and AdS(2)

evidence.text: How does the near-horizon geometry control low-frequency retarded correlators, Fermi-surface excitations and possible instabilities of strongly coupled finite-density systems?

sources.title: Towards strange metallic holography

evidence.text: Can controlled holographic models of finite-density, gapped charge carriers coupled to a neutral Lifshitz critical sector reproduce anomalous DC, optical, and Hall transport associated with strange metals?

sources.title: The Shear Viscosity to Entropy Ratio: A Status Report

evidence.text: What explains holographic universality of η/s, how do higher-curvature, finite-N and finite-coupling effects violate or preserve the KSS bound, and can microscopic consistency impose a replacement lower bound?

sources.title: Holographic Q-lattices

evidence.text: Can explicit holographic lattices be constructed using ODEs, and can they realize metallic and insulating transport? Does the resulting optical conductivity exhibit the proposed intermediate-frequency power law?

sources.title: Wilson loop calculation in QGP using non-supersymmetric AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How do velocity, dipole orientation, temperature-related parameters, and running coupling affect heavy-quark screening and the quark–antiquark potential in a non-supersymmetric holographic plasma?

sources.title: Generalized global symmetries in states with dynamical defects: The case of the transverse sound in field theory and holography

evidence.text: Can conserved populations of dynamical line defects support a symmetry-based description of viscoelasticity and transverse sound without specifying their microscopic origin, and can a holographic model reproduce and delimit that description?

sources.title: Universal Bounds on Transport in Holographic Systems with Broken Translations

evidence.text: Which lower and upper transport bounds survive explicit or spontaneous translation breaking, and should conformal sound bounds constrain longitudinal phonon speed or thermodynamic stiffness?

sources.title: Holographic conformal order in supergravity

evidence.text: The shared setting tests scalar condensates in M2-brane holography through two consistent truncations of four-dimensional gauged supergravity. A real scalar and planar metric describe the candidate ordered thermal states.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How can a gravitational model describe finite-temperature solids and fluids with broken spatial translations? Derivative invariants of bulk Stückelberg scalars distinguish solid and fluid potentials, while an asymptotically AdS4 black brane supplies the thermal state.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can weak explicit breaking produce transverse propagation in a fluid whose spontaneously broken phase has zero elastic shear modulus? The source reports that it can, through light pseudo-phonons.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How does the competition between explicit and spontaneous spacetime-symmetry breaking change the low-energy collective modes of holographic fluids and solids? The window compares transverse and longitudinal pole spectra, including pseudo-phonons, relaxation, and sound–diffusion interactions.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Which boundary observable supplies nonlinear shear stress from the driven geometry?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How do broken translations and chiral anomalies affect strongly coupled transport, and can holographic entanglement constrain de Sitter matter or clarify TT̄-deformed theories?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How can hydrodynamics describe broken translations, and what steady states or universal responses emerge under magnetic fields, periodic driving, or quenches of the symmetry-breaking strength?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Which transport structures survive or arise when a strongly coupled anomalous QFT experiences a strong external magnetic field? The announced calculation probes chiral-anomaly effects on transport, including the viscosity tensor.

sources.title: Higher-derivative holography with a chemical potential

evidence.text: How do non-minimal higher-derivative electromagnetic interactions change holographic current correlators, charged-plasma thermodynamics, viscosity and entanglement when treated non-perturbatively, subject to proposed physical constraints?

sources.title: Universal aspects of holographic quantum critical transport with self-duality

evidence.text: Which charge-transport properties are universal in neutral thermal CFTs holographic to exactly electromagnetic-duality-invariant nonminimal extensions of four-dimensional Einstein–Maxwell theory, and when can curvature couplings modify them?

sources.title: The dual Ginzburg-Landau theory for a holographic superconductor: finite coupling corrections

evidence.text: What Ginzburg-Landau theory describes a minimal holographic superconductor after leading finite-'t Hooft-coupling corrections, and how do its condensate, characteristic lengths, and magnetic classification depend on the holographic dictionary and field normalization?

sources.title: The phase diagram of confining holographic theories on constant curvature manifolds in the presence of a θ-angle

evidence.text: How do dimensionless curvature and the θ-angle determine acceptable ground-state saddles and phase transitions of confining holographic QFTs, and can the axial sector supply a boundary order parameter?

sources.title: The Shear viscosity of strongly coupled N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills plasma

evidence.text: What is the shear viscosity of finite-temperature N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory at large N and strong 't Hooft coupling, and what might connect this result to its weak-coupling behavior?

sources.title: Witten-Veneziano from Green-Schwarz

evidence.text: Can the Witten–Veneziano relation for the η′ mass be obtained holographically by identifying the closed-string mode responsible for generalized Green–Schwarz cancellation of the axial anomaly with the η′?

sources.title: Viscosity in strongly interacting quantum field theories from black hole physics

evidence.text: Does shear viscosity divided by entropy density have a universal value in thermal field theories with black-brane duals, and could that value bound a broader class of fluids from below?

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: The authors report agreement among four methods: Kubo and stretched-horizon calculations nonperturbative in λGB, plus shear diffusion and sound attenuation poles at linear order. The membrane calculation uses Kaluza-Klein reduction to a generalized Maxwell action.

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Expand the action to quadratic order in h₁₂, Fourier transform as e^{−iωt+iqx₃}, and obtain its radial wave equation. The retarded stress-tensor correlator gives η in the small-frequency, small-momentum limit.

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Compute zero-spatial-momentum conductivity from an Ax perturbation with e^{-iωt} dependence and ingoing horizon boundary conditions. Use its boundary coefficients for linear response and Kramers–Kronig relations to associate an imaginary pole with a real conductivity delta function.

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: Solve the fully backreacted radial equations by numerical shooting from a regular horizon, imposing source-free scalar boundary conditions. Compare equilibrium free energies using the regulated Euclidean action with gravitational and scalar boundary counterterms.

sources.title: Real time response on dS(3): The Topological AdS Black Hole and the Bubble

evidence.text: Separate scalar waves into spatial harmonics and de Sitter modes, solve the radial equation using hypergeometric functions, impose Son–Starinets infalling conditions, and extract correlators from the on-shell boundary action.

sources.title: Landscape versus Swampland for Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Survey positive-energy constraints on conformal anomaly coefficients a and c and their application to Gauss–Bonnet duals.

sources.title: Exotic holographic RG flows at finite temperature

evidence.text: How do finite-temperature states modify exotic holographic RG flows with skipping, bounces or irrelevant-operator vevs, and what do their thermodynamics imply about phase structure, vacuum moduli and consistency?
